audit.why: The content chart already reads Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Skill, Master Yi, Master Yi, which is exactly the packet levelChart, and all seven whys agree with it. No flips proposed. It also matches the 49.75% headline over 601 games: a lane Darius owns outright until Yi's first attack-speed item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike and the first-item spike both describe the shift in vague terms — 'let him slip your Guillotine setups' and 'his attack-speed spike out-DPSes you' — without the mechanic behind either.
audit.why: At 6 the relevant fact is that Alpha Strike makes him untargetable (Riot: 'teleports across the battlefield... while simultaneously becoming untargetable'), so a Guillotine cast into it is spent for nothing — and that Meditate is a channel you can cancel. At first item the relevant fact is that attack speed is multiplied by Wuju Style's TRUE damage on basic attacks, so buying armour into the spike is the wrong response.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike now pairs the untargetable dodge with the Meditate cancel; the first-item spike names Wuju Style's true damage and points itemisation at Grievous Wounds rather than armour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Highlander is never mentioned anywhere on this page. Neither is the fact that it grants immunity to slows.
audit.why: Riot: Highlander 'temporarily increas[es] his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects', on a flat 85s, and champion kills or assists extend it while reducing his other cooldowns. Darius' entire stick-to-target plan runs on Crippling Strike's slow and, in most builds, Stridebreaker — both of which stop working the instant he presses R. That is the difference between a run-down that lands and one that never touches him.
audit.corrected: content late now states the 85s slow immunity and warns that Crippling Strike and Stridebreaker stop sticking; whys[6] carries the same fact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is named three times but never identified as a channel, so the page never tells you that you can simply cancel it.
audit.why: Meditate is a flat 10s channel that restores health, reduces damage taken, and pauses the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander while he holds it. Apprehend is a pull — a displacement — and the kit flags Meditate 'interruptible: any CC cancels it'. Pulling a channelling Yi deletes the heal, the damage reduction and the duration pause in one button. Grievous Wounds cuts what does land.
audit.corrected: spikes[2], content mid, whys[4] and wants.you[2] now say to pull him out of the channel rather than to race it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike is treated as always-available. Its cooldown is never given, and neither is the thing that shortens it.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20s at rank 1 and 'basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown'. So the dodge that beats your Guillotine is not on a fixed timer — every auto he lands on the wave or on you brings it back sooner. Denying his farm is also denying his escape, which is the argument for the freeze the page already recommends.
audit.corrected: content mid now gives the 20s and the auto-attack reduction, and ties holding R to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Darius' own E is called 'Apprehension' in three places — content early, spikes[0].text and whys[1]. The ability is Apprehend.
audit.why: A wrong name on the reader's OWN champion is the worst kind on this site, and the packet's suspectName scan did not catch it because it only checks the enemy's abilities.
audit.corrected: All three replaced with Apprehend, and the 535 range added where it fits the space.

edits.before: Stomp the door shut early. Decimate's outer blade out-ranges and out-heals anything he does at 1, level 2 adds the Apprehension threat that keeps him off the wave entirely, and by 3 one pull means a stacked bleed he can't sustain through. Zone him off every CS and force the lane so far ahead his scaling arrives late.
edits.after: Stomp the door shut early. Decimate's outer blade out-ranges and out-heals anything he does at 1, level 2 adds the Apprehend threat at 535 that keeps him off the wave, and by 3 one pull means a stacked bleed he can't sustain through. Zone him off every CS and force the lane so far ahead his scaling arrives late.

edits.before: He gets slippery at 6 — Meditate and Alpha Strike let him survive and dodge your Guillotine setups — so hold R until Alpha is burned or the bleed has done its work. His first item is the flip: the attack-speed spike out-DPSes you in a clean fight. Stop taking clean fights; start every one with E and fight inside your minions.
edits.after: He gets slippery at 6 — Alpha Strike is 20s and untargetable, and his own basic attacks shorten it, so deny him autos and hold R until it is burned. Apprehend cancels a Meditate channel outright. His first item is the flip: stop taking clean fights, start every one with E, and fight inside your minions.

edits.before: His true damage wins any duel where the pull misses, so make missing impossible or make the duel never happen. Sidelane with wave advantage so he fights you in a minion sea, flash-E when it kills, and in teamfights stand mid-scrum stacking bleeds — five stacks plus resets still murder him if he ever commits onto your team.
edits.after: Wuju Style's true damage wins any duel where the pull misses, and Highlander at 85s makes him immune to slows, so Crippling Strike and Stridebreaker stop sticking the second he presses it. Sidelane in a minion sea, flash-E when it kills, and in fights stack bleeds mid-scrum — five stacks plus resets still murder him.

edits.before: The outer-blade heal plus Apprehension threat keeps him off the wave entirely — starve him now.
edits.after: The outer-blade heal plus a 535-range Apprehend keeps him off the wave entirely — starve him.

edits.before: Meditate and Alpha Strike let him slip your Guillotine setups — the free kills end here.
edits.after: Alpha Strike goes untargetable and eats a Guillotine cast — but Apprehend cancels Meditate.

edits.before: The flip: his attack-speed spike out-DPSes you in a clean fight. Stop taking clean fights — open with E or don't open.
edits.after: The flip: attack speed multiplies Wuju Style's true damage, so armour is the wrong buy. Open with E and Grievous Wounds.

edits.after: Level 2 stays yours: the outer-blade heal plus Apprehend's 535 threat keeps him off the wave, starved.

edits.after: Level 6 goes even — Alpha Strike is untargetable and slips your Guillotine, though Apprehend still cancels Meditate mid-channel.

edits.before: Two-plus items stay his — true-damage burst wins any duel where he dodges the E. You need the pull, minion cover, or teammates; he just needs a straight line.
edits.after: Two-plus items stay his — Wuju Style's true damage wins any duel where he dodges the E, and Highlander's slow immunity means Crippling Strike never sticks.

notes: NO FULL-LAYER ENTRY EXISTS for darius vs masteryi — CHAMP_FULL.darius.masteryi is undefined, so this matchup renders off the content layer alone and every full-layer path (tldr, winCon, phases, breakdown, dosFull, report) is missing. I did not use "before": null to build one: apply-proposals.js resolves fEntry from indexFull BEFORE create mode runs, so a full edit against a missing enemy entry fails 'full entry not found' regardless. Worse, a partially created entry would be actively harmful — MatchupCoach.dc.html reads FULL.breakdown.early unguarded once FULL is truthy, so any full entry lacking a breakdown object throws and takes the page down. This one needs a whole entry authored at once, not field-by-field. Derived-flag misfire, reported not acted on: masteryi.json tags Highlander (R) with 'slow: kiting and disengage tool', but Riot's text says the opposite — it makes him 'immune to all slowing effects'. I wrote the description, not the flag. Also worth the user's attention: the packet reported no defects and no suspectNames for this matchup, yet Darius' own E was mis-named 'Apprehension' in three separate fields; the suspectName scan only checks enemy ability names, so owner-side name errors pass through it silently across the whole repo.
